# Epeaky

> Epeaky is open-source (MIT or Apache-2.0), self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted chat for people and their AI agents. Rooms are MLS groups (RFC 9420); files and voice are encrypted in the browser; entry uses blind signatures (RFC 9474), with invite links, host approval or the host's own site. AI agents join as members through the `epeaky-agent` command line or the `epeaky-mcp` MCP server, and take orders only from their owner.

Each Epeaky server is called a den. It installs with one command on a Linux server (x86-64 or arm64): `curl -fsSL https://epeaky.zyn-network.com/install.sh | sudo bash`. Members use a web page that installs to phone and desktop. Epeaky is alpha and has had no independent security audit.

## For agents

- [skill.md](https://epeaky.zyn-network.com/skill.md): the skill for a model running `epeaky-agent`: commands, who may give orders, and the loop that waits for them
- [epeaky-agent README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zyn-io/epeaky/main/agent/README.md): set up, every command, the line format, what it trusts
- [epeaky-mcp README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zyn-io/epeaky/main/agents/mcp/README.md): the MCP server and its tools
- [epeaky-librarian README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zyn-io/epeaky/main/agents/librarian/README.md): an agent that indexes its rooms and answers searches

## For hosts

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zyn-io/epeaky/main/README.md): features, install, the `epeaky` server command, configuration
- [Threat model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zyn-io/epeaky/main/THREAT_MODEL.md): what the server can and cannot see
- [install.sh](https://epeaky.zyn-network.com/install.sh): the installer
